lines.text: Every successful organisation shares one common strength… its people.
At OQ RPI, behind every operation, every innovation, and every achievement, lies talent.
In a fast-changing energy sector, OQ RPI must have the right talent, in the right roles, at the right time.
OQ RPI Talent Management exists to build sustainable workforce capability, strengthen our leadership pipeline, and secure the future of our business.
At OQ RPI, Talent Management is not a collection of separate programmes. It is one integrated ecosystem.
Brought together in our Talent Command Center, each programme generates insights, actions and data that strengthen the next.
At OQ RPI Talent Management, Performance Management enables us to assess, measure, and recognise employee contribution while supporting strategic talent decisions.
It is the foundation for every talent decision we make.
Through our annual Talent Review, the OQ RPI 9-Box Matrix combines performance and potential to identify our future leaders and accelerate their development.
Not every position at OQ RPI carries the same level of risk.
Our Critical Roles framework identifies the positions whose vacancy would impact safety, operations, leadership continuity, or business performance.
At OQ RPI Talent Management, Succession Planning ensures critical positions have identified and developed successors to support business continuity.
At OQ RPI Talent Management, leadership development programmes such as MASAR and ROBBAN build future leaders and strengthen organisational capability.
At OQ RPI, Nationalization develops and advances Omani talent into critical roles and leadership positions, with a named successor for every role we nationalize.
Through Secondment Management, OQ RPI employees gain broader exposure across OQ and national institutions, accelerating their learning and bringing new capability home.
OQ RPI Rewards and Recognition, from Testahal to Above and Beyond, reinforces the behaviours we value and celebrates the people who make our success possible.
The OQ RPI Talent Command Center brings our talent data together, giving leaders real-time visibility of critical roles, bench strength, succession readiness, and leadership pipelines.
And our Talent Assistant answers any question on talent data, in English or Arabic.
Together, these initiatives form the OQ RPI Talent Management ecosystem, transforming data into decisions, potential into capability, and employees into future leaders.
For every employee, it means clear expectations, real development, and a visible path to grow with OQ RPI.
The future is not built by systems. It is built by people.
By investing in our people today, OQ RPI is creating the leaders, capabilities, and opportunities that will shape tomorrow.
OQ RPI Talent Management. Building tomorrow's talent, together.
